text:
Elliot C: hey all, first day here! quick security/setup q's: 1) my security training is scheduled during a customer call, can i move it? 2) my Mac shows FileVault not enabledshould i try enabling manually? 3) do i request KMS now for the dev sandbox or later?

Anita P: welcome Elliot :tada: you can reschedule the training in the portal (https://redwood.internal/training) or tell us preferred times and we'll adjust. for Macs, enroll in MDM first (Self Service -> Enroll Device). the FileVault profile should be pushed automatically after enrollment. badge pickup is Reception 2, bring photo id.

Samir J: hey Elliot, cc'ing IT. please run `fdesetup status` and paste output here. if it says Not Enabled, don't run `sudo fdesetup` yourselfwe manage escrow via MDM. share the serial (About This Mac) and i'll push the profile. for Windows run `manage-bde -status C:`.

IT Bot: Ticket created: #IT-49320 for device enrollment (owner: Samir J). ETA ~45-90 minutes.

Maya R: quick KMS note: engineers don't get full KMS by default. open the KMS access request (https://redwood.internal/sec/kms-request) with your manager's approval. for dev sandbox we can often issue short-lived creds instead. also heads-up: phishing simulation runs this weekit's benign and part of baseline training. reporting it = training, not punishment. contractors: flag People Ops for exemptions.

Elliot C: serial is C02ZPQ7LM456. i picked 10-11am tomorrow for training instead. i ran `fdesetup status` and it returned: "FileVault is Off". i'll wait for MDM push.

Samir J: got the serial, pushing enrollment/profile now. i'll post when FileVault flips to Enabled. if not done in 2h we'll escalate to onsite.

Anita P: training moved to 10-11am tomorrow. welcome again 60a ping me if badge or laptop issues.

IT Bot: Ticket #IT-49320 updated: enrollment push started by Samir J.

Maya R: Elliot, watch for a simulated phish from security@redwood-sim.local in next 48h. safe to report it or use the report button.

Elliot C: thanks everyone :pray: i'll report back once FileVault shows enabled.
